snippet.title: AURATITAN: Sage 2026 Trailer
snippet.description:
AuraTitan, the Co-Op run-n-gun movement platformer hybrid, is making its playable debut in a demo featuring the first 4 stages at #SAGE2026! 

AuraTitan is a Co-Op run-'n'-gun / movement platformer hybrid, starring the titular AuraTitans, Kita and Vana! Along the way, they'll be using the many mystical Auras of Shatterstar Island to save the world.


Their journey wont be easy, however; the evil Dr Isaac Murabito has sent his evil Aura Hunters, each infused with their own elemental Aura to the island. It's up to you to put a stop to his invasion!

AuraTitan combines run-'n'-gun Co-Op action with a moveset that’s easy to learn and hard to master. As you play and defeat each Aura Hunter, you'll obtain a brand new permanent addition to your moveset, so you'll always be learning new movement options. If you're a newbie to platformers, or looking for something to flex your movement skills, AuraTitan's movement keeps you moving and on your toes!

follow AuraTitan updates on my bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/software-bunny.bsky.social
